items.title: How much does the value framing's dollar figure actually depend on?
items.description: Reproduces L3's cost comparison. Defaults ($1.50/bottle, 2 bottles/day) reproduce the unit's exact $1,028.50 first-year savings figure: bottled water for one year minus the first year of pitcher plus filter costs. Drag either slider to see how much the pitch's headline number depends on the specific listener's actual bottled-water habits.
items.compute: const bottledYear = params.bottlePrice * params.bottlesPerDay * 365; const filterYear1 = 30 + (0.5 * 365 / 40) * 8; return { yearOneSavings: Math.round((bottledYear - filterYear1) * 100) / 100 };
